score_ledger.threshold_or_test: pass if event_total>=150 mm, wettest_72h_fraction>=0.90, wet_hours_share>=0.60, and longest_wet_run>=48 h
single-hour control is rejected when both ratios are below 0.10
uniform transfer is rejected when point ratios exceed 3 and grid-max ratios exceed 5
pass if duration>=72 h, mean_intensity>=8 mm/h, and C=0.50 runoff exceeds 300000 m3/km2
wind and image dominance are rejected when all three low-signal tests pass

decision_rule.final_label_rule: Use the final label when rainfall persistence and runoff load pass while peak-hour, uniform-transfer, wind, and image dominance tests are rejected.

criteria.name: Compact JSON ledger
criteria.description: Returns target_family, five required ledger rows with formulas, computed values, tests, results, and the final label.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for valid JSON with missing rows or incomplete row fields.

criteria.name: Rainfall persistence calculation
criteria.description: Computes 196.9 mm, 187.2 mm, 0.951, 84 wet hours, 0.700 wet-hour share, and 78-hour longest wet run, then marks the row as passing.
criteria.partial_credit: 2-3 points for mostly correct values with one threshold or unit error.

criteria.name: Peak-hour concentration rejection
criteria.description: Computes 17.5 mm, 0.089, and 0.093 and rejects single-hour control.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for the right rejection with incomplete ratio work.

criteria.name: Report-total transfer ratios
criteria.description: Computes 3.78, 3.38, 9.26, and 12.79 and rejects uniform report-total transfer.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for using only point comparisons or only grid comparisons.

criteria.name: Runoff-equivalent load
criteria.description: Derives 8.97 mm/h, 215.4 mm/day, 372400 m3/km2, and 521360 m3/km2 and applies the severe-runoff threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for correct intensity or volume computation but not both.

criteria.name: Wind and image dominance test
criteria.description: Rejects wind or image dominance using 38.5 km/h, -0.0142 dB, and 0.0175.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for using only wind or only image values.

criteria.name: Final routing label
criteria.description: Uses the final label persistent_remnant_rainfall_runoff_haihe_routing and keeps the interpretation tied to the computed ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for a correct label with loose interpretation, or a correct interpretation with a noncanonical label.

provenance.data_basis: Report anchors are parsed from local WMO HTML; precipitation, wind, grid, and remote-sensing metrics are recomputed from local package files.
provenance.notes: The duplicate WMO HTML mirror is listed so provenance covers both local report copies that contain the 744.8 mm / 83 h anchor.
